slide_text: The notation you just invented is called Big O notation . Computer scientists write: $[math][math]O(f(n))[math]f(n)[math]O(n^2)[math]n^2$.

fragments.text: The formal notation was introduced by Paul Bachmann in 1894 but the idea is exactly what you discovered: classify algorithms by their growth family, ignore the constants.
